meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接入你指定的 GitHub 仓库,在 PR 和 Issue 的评论线程里参与对话。有人在评论里 @ 机器人账号时它才回应,之后该线程的后续评论它都会跟上。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 Issue 评论里 @ 你配置的机器人账号时触发;私库默认可放行所有评论者,公开库只允许已登记的成员触发。

say.text: 帮我给 GitHub 加个频道,仓库是 acme/backend
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器

say.text: 这个公开库用 strict 策略,只让已登记成员触发机器人

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins the GitHub repos you pick and replies in pull request and issue comment threads as conversations. It answers when someone @-mentions the bot account, then follows all later comments in that thread.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the configured bot account in a PR or issue comment. Private repos pass all comments; public repos only let registered members trigger it.

say_en.text: Add a GitHub channel for the repo acme/backend
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: Use strict policy for this public repo so only members trigger the bot
Wire this GitHub channel to my agent group with per-thread sessions
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group and a wiring
